_why: Foreign keys whose SOURCE SCOPE no binding of the parent ever produces, acknowledged.
A federated key prepends its source name as a literal, so the scope alone decides
joinability whatever columns follow. verify_repo fails on any such key NOT listed here,
and separately fails on any entry here that has STOPPED being an orphan -- so this file
can neither hide a new one nor outlive the reason for an old one.
IT IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF KEEPING IT. Five orphans existed on the morning of
4 September 2026 and all five are closed. An empty register is not a dead file: the gate
reads it on every run, so the day a sixth appears the build fails and whoever caused it
has to either fix the key or write down here why it cannot be fixed. Deleting the file
Empty. Held four keys where the child was keyed correctly for its feed but the parent
hub had no binding for that feed.

_closed_4_september_2026: All five, in the order they were closed:
1. csat_payroll_line_classification/BUSINESS_VAULT/payroll_detail_hk -- DEF-53. Hashed
under its own binding name, which is not a source system. Fixed with key_scope:
UKG_US, verified byte-identical to nhl_payroll_detail's own key.
2. nhl_payroll_detail/UKG_US/worker_hk -- hub_worker had no UKG_US binding. Added one,
reading the same payroll register the NHL reads. Purely additive: one new
key_derivation entry, one digest moved, and the hub held only its ghost row.
3-5. The three job_request keys. NOT a missing binding: hub_job_request had ONE business
key position and those children hashed TWO, so a binding was rejected outright. Closed
by making the hub key_style: tenant_scoped with the tenant as its first key position --
because Fieldglass is multi-tenant (200+ US clients) and a posting reference is unique
only within a tenant, so the old key would have merged two clients' postings into one
hub row, silently. The three non-tenanted sources supply NOT_APPLICABLE for that
position; FIELDGLASS_US fills both positions from columns.
That re-key cost 45,516 hub rows and 46,889 satellite rows, and it forced six
hub-parented satellite bindings to declare parent_keys: without it they take factory's
fallback, which hashes their own key_columns and knows nothing about the hub's literal,
so every one of them would have become a NEW orphan. The gates caught all six.
Also corrected in the same change: the bindings were named FIELDGLASS_EU. There is no
Fieldglass EU -- the instances are US, UK and APAC -- and because a source name is hashed
INTO a federated key, that name was part of the identity of every row they would have
loaded. UK and APAC are NOT declared: a binding to a source nobody has verified is the
mistake being corrected, not a pattern to repeat.
